title: Zhongke Runzi Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Zhongke Runzi Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese aerogel materials company founded in 2013 and focused on the research, industrialization, and application of aerogel nanotechnology. The company publicly presents a broad series of aerogel insulation, fire-protection, acoustic, and specialty materials for multiple downstream sectors.

Company Overview

Zhongke Runzi combines material R&D, production, and commercial application around aerogel composite products and related solutions. Its published product range includes blankets, membranes, boards, coatings, concrete, glass, and multiple end-use systems spanning LNG, oil and gas, buildings, batteries, logistics, and apparel.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with broader business-development ambitions.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, LNG and deep-cold systems, new energy and storage, buildings and fire protection, corrosion protection, and cold-chain applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel insulation felt, blanket, and membrane products
  • Aerogel insulation boards
  • Aerogel concrete and aerogel glass
  • Aerogel coatings and solution-oriented composite materials
